title: Anchor States Along a Round Orbit
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with state set $S$, let $a\in S$, and let $R$ be a round contract for $M$ at anchor $a$. If $c$ starts in state $a$, the precondition holds at every orbit configuration with index $r<n$, and each round endpoint with $r+1<n$ returns to state $a$, then every orbit configuration with index $r<n$ is in state $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A round contract $R$ for machine $M$ with anchor $a$
The precondition holds at every orbit index $r<n$
Every round endpoint with $r+1<n$ has state $a$
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine, let $a$ be a state, and let $R$ be a round contract for
$M$ anchored at $a$. If a configuration $c$ starts in state $a$, the round precondition
holds at every orbit configuration with index $r<n$, and every round endpoint with
$r+1<n$ returns to state $a$, then every orbit configuration with index $r<n$ is in
state $a$.
